company.shortDescription: Dresos is an AI powered retail solution that delivers personalized outfits for any occasion without charging styling or delivery fees.
company.description: Dresos FZ LLC is a fashion technology and AI-driven retail company that develops personalised shopping solutions for clothing and fashion brands. The platform uses artificial intelligence and data analytics to recommend curated outfits to customers based on their preferences, body measurements, style choices, and purchasing behaviour. The company focuses on improving online fashion shopping by helping consumers discover clothing that fits their style, size, and budget more accurately.
